assets.prompt: A small exploration spacecraft entering an alien atmosphere, six seconds. Starts with a restrained deep engine rumble, builds into rushing turbulent air and a warm plasma crackle around the hull, then softens smoothly. Cinematic science fiction game sound, no explosion, no alarm, no music, no speech.

Steady downward landing thrusters of a small industrial exploration spaceship, six seconds of smooth continuous low turbine roar with soft pressurized air and restrained hull vibration. Even sustained texture for a seamless loop, close exterior perspective, no impacts, no startup or shutdown, no voices, no music.

A single controlled touchdown of a compact exploration spacecraft on rocky soil. Immediate deep padded landing-gear thud and short gravel crunch, a quick hydraulic settling hiss, then a brief turbine spin-down fading into silence. About two seconds of action with quiet tail. Solid and reassuring, no crash, no explosion, no music, no voices.
